data.exact_reserve_text: Driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications, the 2013 year of account declares a loss on capacity of 5.9%. The 2014 year of account currently forecasts closing at a break even position.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2013 year of account declares a loss on capacity of 5.9% due to higher than anticipated claims notifications.

data.standardized_narrative: The 2013 year of account experienced adverse development, declaring a loss on capacity of 5.9% driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications. The 2014 year of account is currently forecasting a break-even position. No specific gross prior year reserve movement amount is quantified in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: Driven by higher than anticipated claims notifications
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior year development figure was found. The narrative mentions a loss on capacity for the 2013 year of account due to higher than anticipated claims notifications, and a break-even forecast for the 2014 year of account. The 'Gross Claims Development' table is not a standard cumulative claims incurred triangle and could not be used to calculate prior year development. Gross premium mix is derived from the 'Operating divisions' table, which is a divisional breakdown rather than a regulatory segmental analysis.
